policy: A sample may be discarded only if its permit is active. Emergency samples may be discarded without a permit.

governed_action.description: Discards one sample; result state=discarded means completion.

condition_menu.tool_description: Reports sample.emergency for the specified sample.
Reports sample.permit_active for the specified sample.

policy: Energize a feeder only after both lockout clearance and operator authorization are recorded.

governed_action.description: Energizes one feeder; result state=energized means completion.

condition_menu.tool_description: Reports feeder.lockout_clear for the specified feeder.
Reports feeder.operator_authorized for the specified feeder.
